title: Zwoice — Great conversations ride beside you.
description: Voice chat for Zwift. Talk automatically with other Zwoice riders near you. For Windows, macOS and Linux. Just sign in with your email and ride.
ogDescription: Close the gap. Join the chat. Zwoice brings spontaneous conversations to your virtual ride.
heroLead: Suffer together. Chat. Ride one more lap. Zwoice connects you with the riders around you – just like outside.
noPassword: Just your email. No password, no invite.
noteWindows: For Intel, AMD and ARM. No admin rights needed.
noteMacos: One download for Apple silicon and Intel. macOS 12 or later.
noteLinux: For 64-bit PCs with an Intel or AMD processor.
installWindows: Open the downloaded file. The installer adds Zwoice to the Start menu and can launch it right away.
installMacos: Open the DMG file, drag Zwoice into Applications and open the app from there.
installLinux: Unpack the archive and run the included zwoice file. Your browser opens automatically.
appLanguageNote: Heads-up: the Zwoice app itself is currently in German.
mobileNote: Zwoice runs on your computer. Open this page there to install it.
sceneLabel: Example of a Zwoice ride: three riders within earshot, with volume adjusted automatically. Schematic preview.
previewCaption: Great conversations start right beside you.
proximityText1: No room to find. No call to answer. As soon as other active Zwoice riders are near you, you can hear each other.
proximityText2: Dropping back? Voices fade out gently. Back in the gruppetto, the conversation picks up again.
micHint: Go on: give it a click.
micHintMuted: Nobody can hear you. Click to unmute.
controlText1: Your mic, your volume, your call. Mute yourself or individual riders whenever you like.
controlText2: Zwoice runs in the background. Voice is encrypted and never recorded by Zwoice.
voicesText: Up to six riders near you. Enough for a gruppetto, too few for a din.
zeroText: No recording, no analytics scripts, no stored location history.
mailText: Enter your email, confirm the code, done. No invite needed.
lockText: Voice travels encrypted directly between riders, via a relay when needed.
shieldText: Connect via relay only if you like. Your IP stays hidden from other riders.
soundText: Opus audio with echo and noise suppression. Volume follows distance, automatically.
platformsText: A small program plus the browser you already have. No bundled Chromium, no bloat.
step1Text: Get Zwoice for Windows, macOS or Linux and open it.
step2Text: Enter your email and confirm the code from your inbox. Stay signed in for 30 days if you like.
step3Text: Start Zwift and Sauce, click “Fahrt starten” (start ride) and allow the microphone. Zwoice does the rest.
requirementsText1: You need Zwift and Sauce for Zwift with its web server enabled. Zwoice detects your rider automatically and helps you connect.
requirementsText2: The people you talk to use Zwoice and Sauce too. Zwift and Sauce are separate apps with their own accounts and terms.
finalTitle: You can’t scroll any further. So: clip in.
installUnsigned: The packages aren’t currently signed with a verified publisher certificate, and the macOS package isn’t notarized yet. Windows or macOS may therefore ask for an extra security confirmation the first time you open it.
installDevices: Apple TV, iPhone and Android can’t run Zwoice directly. Zwoice supports Linux; Zwift itself needs a supported platform.
installLink: All packages, checksums and release notes
footerIndependent: Independent of Zwift, Sauce LLC and Discord.
